sam: Heads-up — PR #4822 is red on CI. Integration matrix failed on the linux-x86 axis right after the db-migration step. Can someone remind me the command to retrigger only the integration job without rebuilding images?

ci-bot: buildkite: https://buildkite.example.com/teams/redwood/pipelines/infra-ci/builds/98765 — step integration-tests failed (exit code 1). 

maria: You can run our internal tool: `cictl rerun --build 98765 --step integration-tests --skip-image-build` — that restarts the step(s) but avoids the docker image rebuild. Works for a single build ID.

sam: I don't have cictl locally, what's the quick install?

maria: quick bootstrap: `curl -sL https://internal.redwood.tools/cictl.sh | bash` or use the web UI and restart the single step (three dots -> Restart specific jobs). The cli is just handier for scripts.

lee: If you prefer the UI: open the build, expand the matrix, click the failing agent, Restart step. But note: restarting from UI sometimes kicks off the image build depending on the pipeline config — use `--skip-image-build` if you want to avoid that.

devops-jen: If the failure is flaky and you're seeing the same test keep failing across restarts, consider a bisect: `./scripts/ci/bisect.sh --range=main..pr/4822 --target=integration --parallel=4` — that will run binary-search builds to find the first bad commit for that integration step. It requires a couple hours and a temp key (we auto-provision when you run it).

sam: I ran `cictl rerun --build 98765 --step integration-tests --skip-image-build` — it restarted the linux-x86 axis only but it's still failing on the same test: `tests/integration/test_sessions.py::test_create_session` with a 120s timeout. Log snippet:```
E   TimeoutError: did not receive READY event within 120s
...
INFO  migration applied: 2026_03_15_add_session_index
```

alex: That's a recurring flake we've seen on that node. Two quick options: (1) bump the flaky retry for that test in `pytest.ini` for the integration group temporarily, or (2) rerun just that axis again a couple times. To rerun only that matrix axis: `cictl rerun --build 98765 --axis=linux-x86 --step integration-tests --skip-image-build`

maria: If you actually want to rebuild images but not re-run everything (rebuild-only): `cictl rebuild --build 98765 --images --only` — that will push new images but won't kick off tests unless you then invoke `rerun`. Useful if you suspect an image-related flake.

sam: ok doing another axis-only rerun. If it keeps failing I'll kick off the bisect and ping @eng-oncall. Thanks all :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Build 98765 retriggered (axis: linux-x86). New build link: https://buildkite.example.com/teams/redwood/pipelines/infra-ci/builds/98766
